program.name: Step Up
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Single-leg strength built on step-ups and Bulgarian split squats, one leg at a time.
program.about: Leg strength one side at a time, built on step-ups and Bulgarian split squats. One day centres on split squats and lunges, the other on step-ups and single-leg hinges, both with a little squatting and abs to finish. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III brings harder variations. You need a sturdy chair or step.
